title: The Best Writing Starter 3 Gap Fill

units.name: Unit 01: Dream Jobs
units.title: Dream Jobs
lines: My friends and I have dream [jobs].
I want to be a [musician].
I like to [write songs] and play the guitar.
My best friend Kelly [wants] to be a content creator.
She likes to [make videos] and create content for YouTube.
She's really good at it!
My close friend Shawn wants to be a chef.
He likes to [try new foods] and cook for others.
I wish our [dreams] come true.

units.name: Unit 02: Tastes of Food
units.title: Tastes of Food
lines: There are many different [tastes] in food.
The pizza is [delicious].
It has bacon in it, so it's [salty].
The pasta is good.
It has [pepper] in it, so it's spicy.
The lemonade is good.
It has lemon in it, [so] it's sour.
The cupcakes are tasty.
They have chocolate in [them], so they're sweet.
I enjoy all the salty, spicy, sour, and [sweet] tastes.

units.name: Unit 03: My Daily Routine
units.title: My Daily Routine
lines: I have busy [weekdays].
In the morning, I [wake up] at seven.
I eat breakfast at seven thirty.
I take the [school bus] around eight twenty.
[In the afternoon], I come home at two.
I do my homework [around] three.
In the evening, I [practice] the piano at six.
I have dinner around seven.
At night, I write a [diary] at nine.
I go to sleep around ten.

units.name: Unit 04: Animals vs. Humans
units.title: Fish vs. Humans
lines: This is my report on fish and humans.
Fish and humans are very [different].
Fish live in the water, but humans live on [land].
Fish have [scales], but humans have skin.
Fish can't run, [but] humans can.
Fish can't [blink] their eyes, but humans can.
Fish and humans are similar in some ways.
[Both] fish and humans can swim.
Both fish and humans can eat seaweed.
Fish and humans are both amazing!

units.name: Review 01: Meeting a Friend
units.title: My Text Message
lines: Dorothy: Hey, do you want to [hang out]?
Me: Hi, Dorothy. Sure.
Dorothy: What [time] do you want to meet?
Me: I came home around three.
Let's [meet] at three thirty.
Dorothy: Great! Where do you want to go?
Me: Let's go to the [shopping mall].
Dorothy: Okay. I will see you there.
Me: After that, let's go to the [bookstore].
I want to [buy] a new comic book.
Dorothy: Sounds good. See you then!

units.name: Unit 05: Fun Time with My Family
units.title: Fun Time with My Family
lines: My family does many fun activities together.
When it's [snowy], we usually stay home.
We watch TV and eat cookies.
But sometimes, we go out and make a [snowman].
When it's windy, we [usually] stay home.
We play a [board game] and eat snacks.
But [sometimes], we go out and take a walk.
When it's warm, we usually [go out].
We go on a [picnic] and eat sandwiches.
But sometimes, we stay home and read books.
We always have a great time.

units.name: Unit 06: My Busy Weekend
units.title: My Busy Weekend
lines: I have so much to do this weekend.
[First], I'm going to play soccer with friends.
Second, I'm [going] to go to a party.
Third, I'm going to meet my friends and [see a movie].
Fourth, I'm going to [buy] some books at the bookstore.
[Fifth], I'm going to help around the house.
[Finally], I'm going to walk my dog, Max.
What a weekend!

units.name: Unit 07: Packing List
units.title: Packing List
lines: My family is [packing] for the summer vacation.
Mom will take her [sundress] and sunhat.
She'll take her tablet to read e-books.
She [won't] take her work.
Dad will take [his] swimming goggles and sunglasses.
He'll take his drone to [shoot a video].
He won't take his RC car.
I will take my [swimsuit] and shorts.
I'll take my laptop to play video games.
I won't take my books.

units.name: Unit 08: Gifts for Friends
units.title: Dear Diary
lines: Tuesday, December 15th
Dear Diary,
Christmas is coming.
I think of [gifts] for my friends.
I'll give a baseball mitt to Jack [because] his mitt is too small.
I'll give [gloves] to Tom because the weather is very cold.
I'll [give] a flower pot to Jenny because she loves flowers.
I'll give colored pencils to Christina because she [loves] drawing.
Amelia

units.name: Review 02: I Want a Pet
units.title: Dear Mom and Dad
lines: Dear Mom and Dad,
For my birthday, I really [want] a parrot.
I will take good [care] of it.
First, I'll [feed] the parrot.
Second, I'll [clean up] the parrot's poop.
Third, I'll play with the parrot [every day].
Fourth, I'll clean up the parrot's cage.
Finally, I'll [give] the parrot a bath.
I'll be a good [child].
Please let me have a parrot.
Yours,
Jake
